title: Fusion-Free Multimodal Classification with Heterogeneous Deep Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2607.05019v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In multimodal classification, late-fusion approaches classify concatenated modality-specific features extracted by unimodal neural networks. When modality imbalance is pronounced, various regularization techniques have been proposed to balance the learning process and overcome the inferior performance of late-fusion networks. In contrast, this work demonstrates that multimodal data can be effectively classified without any explicit modality fusion, using deep ensembles of unimodal networks. We systematically compare deep ensembles to late-fusion networks at equal parameter count and show that ensembles consistently outperform state-of-the-art late-fusion methods designed to address modality imbalance when trained from random initialization. translated_title: 无需融合的异构深度集成多模态分类
translated_abstract: 在多模态分类中，后期融合方法对由单模态神经网络提取并拼接的模态特定特征进行分类。当模态不平衡现象显著时，已有多种正则化技术被提出以平衡学习过程并克服后期融合网络性能不佳的问题。相比之下，这项工作表明，多模态数据无需任何显式模态融合即可被有效分类，只需使用单模态网络的深度集成。我们在相同参数量的条件下系统地将深度集成与后期融合网络进行比较，结果显示，在从随机初始化开始训练的情况下，深度集成始终优于为解决模态不平衡而设计的最先进的后期融合方法。这一优势在我们所评估的中间融合技术以及结合单模态和多模态分类器的混合方法上同样成立。我们提出并实证验证了一种方法……
tldr: 该论文证明，无需任何显式模态融合，仅用单模态网络的深度集成在相同参数量下即可持续超越为解决模态不平衡而设计的最先进后期融合及其他融合方法。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that deep ensembles of unimodal networks, without any explicit modality fusion, consistently outperform state-of-the-art late-fusion and other fusion methods at equal parameter count when trained from random initialization.
